```{r}

```

```{r}
#Signifikante CpGs auswählen
significant_CpGs <- DMPs[DMPs$adj.P.Val < 0.05, ] #jetzt sind es 160587 Signifikante CpGs
```

```{r}
library(IlluminaHumanMethylation450kanno.ilmn12.hg19)
```
# Gene ontolgy for Cpgs
```{r}
gst2 <- gometh(sig.cpg = rownames(significant_CpGs),
              all.cpg = rownames(DMPs),
              collection = "GO",
              plot.bias = TRUE)
```

```{r}
GO <- topGSA(gst2, n=10)
GO
```

```{r}
write.csv(GO, file = "GO_enrichment_160587_sig_CpGs.csv")
```

```{r}
gst2.kegg <- gometh(sig.cpg = rownames(significant_CpGs),
              all.cpg = rownames(DMPs),
              collection = "KEGG")
```
```{r}
KEGG <- topGSA(gst2.kegg, n=10)
KEGG
```

```{r}
write.csv(KEGG, file="KEGG_enrichemnt_160587_sig_Cpgs.csv")
```

```{r}
# CpGs in Promoterregionen
gst2.kegg.prom <- gometh(sig.cpg=rownames(significant_CpGs), all.cpg=rownames(DMPs), 
                        collection="KEGG", genomic.features = c("TSS200",
                                                                "TSS1500",
                                                                "1stExon"))
KEGG.promoter <- topGSA(gst2.kegg.prom, n=10)
KEGG.promoter
```

```{r}
write.csv(KEGG.promoter, file = "KEGG_enrichment_160587_sig_CpGs_in_promoter.csv")
```

```{r}
# CpGs in gene bodies
gst2.kegg.body <- gometh(sig.cpg=rownames(significant_CpGs), all.cpg=rownames(DMPs), 
                        collection="KEGG", genomic.features = c("Body"))
KEGG.gene.body <- topGSA(gst2.kegg.body, n=10)
KEGG.gene.body
```

```{r}
write.csv(KEGG.gene.body, file="KEGG_enrichment_160587_sig_CpGs_in_gene_body.csv")
```

```{r}
hallmark <- readRDS(url("http://bioinf.wehi.edu.au/MSigDB/v7.1/Hs.h.all.v7.1.entrez.rds"))
gsa <- gsameth(sig.cpg=rownames(significant_CpGs), all.cpg=rownames(DMPs), collection=hallmark)
```
```{r}
Hallmarks <- topGSA(gsa, n=10)
Hallmarks
```
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
```

```{r}

data <- Hallmarks %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "HallmarkName")

# Erster Plot (ähnlich zu Panel A)
p1 <- ggplot(data, aes(x = DE, y = factor(HallmarkName, levels = rev(HallmarkName)), fill = FDR)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "blue", high = "red", trans = "reverse") +
  labs(x = "Number of genes", y = "", fill = "p.adjust") +
  theme_minimal()
print(p1)

ggsave("Hallmarks_DMPs.pdf", plot=p1, width=8, height = 8)
```


```{r}
write.csv(Hallmarks,file= "Hallmark_gene_set_enrichment_160587_sig_CpGs.csv")
```
# Gene Ontolgy for DMRs
```{r}
library(DMRcatedata)
```


```{r}
gst.region <- goregion(results.ranges.sig,
                      all.cpg=rownames(BRCA_methylation_data_original),
                                       collection="GO",
                                       array.type="450K")
```
```{r}
OG_region <- topGSA(gst.region, n=10)
OG_region
```
```{r}
write.csv(OG_region, file = "GO_enrichment_DMRs.csv")
```

```{r}
gst.region.kegg <- goregion(results.ranges.sig, all.cpg=rownames(BRCA_methylation_data_original), 
                       collection="KEGG", array.type="450K")
```

```{r}
KEGG_region <- topGSA(gst.region.kegg, n=10)
KEGG_region
```
```{r}
write.csv(KEGG_region, file = "KEGG_enrichment_DMRs.csv")
```

```{r}
gsa.region <- gsaregion(results.ranges.sig, all.cpg=rownames(BRCA_methylation_data_original), 
                        collection=hallmark)
```
```{r}
Hallmark_region <- topGSA(gsa.region, n=10)
Hallmark_region
```

```{r}
write.csv(Hallmark_region, file = "Hallmark_gene_set_enrichment_DMRs.csv")
```

```{r}
Intersect_Hallmarks <- intersect(rownames(Hallmark_region),rownames(Hallmarks))
```

```{r}
write.csv(Intersect_Hallmarks, file="Intersect_between_Hallmarks_160587_sig_CpGs_and_DMRs.csv")
```
